source_text:
EXAM: Renal ultrasound.

HISTORY: Renal failure, neurogenic bladder, status-post cystectomy.

TECHNIQUE: Multiple ultrasonographic images of the kidneys were obtained in the transverse and longitudinal planes.

COMPARISON: Most recently obtained mm/dd/yy.

FINDINGS: The right kidney measures 12 x 5.2 x 4.6 cm and the left kidney measures 12.2 x 6.2 x 4.4 cm. The imaged portions of the kidneys fail to demonstrate evidence of mass, hydronephrosis or calculus. There is no evidence of cortical thinning.

Incidentally there is a rounded low-attenuation mass within the inferior aspect of the right lobe of the liver measuring 2.1 x 1.5 x 1.9 cm which has suggestion of some peripheral blood flow.

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of hydronephrosis.
2. Mass within the right lobe of the liver. The patient apparently has a severe iodine allergy. Further evaluation with MRI is recommended.
3. The results of this examination were given to XXX in Dr. XXX office on mm/dd/yy at XXX

annotation_notes: primary_content_type is lab_values because this is a renal ultrasound report consisting of organ measurements and imaging findings. No demographics (age/sex) are stated. The exam type (F1) and 'status-post cystectomy' (F4) were typed procedure; imaging measurements and findings were typed lab_value; the iodine allergy (F10) was typed diagnosis to match the MTS_DEV_01_gold precedent for allergy status, with the report's 'apparently' uncertainty preserved. Impression item 1 ('No evidence of hydronephrosis') restates the FINDINGS and was not recorded as a separate fact to avoid duplication (captured within F7). The TECHNIQUE sentence (imaging method) and the anonymized logistics (COMPARISON date 'mm/dd/yy'; impression item 3 reporting that results were communicated to 'XXX in Dr. XXX office on mm/dd/yy') were excluded as methodology/logistics containing only placeholder values.
